evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: by ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and governance in financial data models and reports, including maintaining finance mapping tables and hierarchies
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Accuracy, governance, well-tested models and regulatory reporting run through the whole posting, and no speed or shipping language appears anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: producing mandatory reporting for German regulatory authorities
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role runs the monthly financial sales closing and produces "mandatory reporting for German regulatory authorities", so errors carry regulatory and financial-reporting consequences.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Team; CFO; Controlling; Accounting; FP&A
evidence.data_team_maturity: by designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models for the Finance domain using dbt and BigQuery on GCP
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A data team, dbt, BigQuery and Looker already exist and appear in the responsibilities, but the finance domain is still being stood up and "not everything is automated yet".
evidence.jd_authorship: by owning critical recurring finance operations, including running the monthly financial sales closing process (Excel), maintaining finance mapping tables (e.g. Geographical Business Unit mappings, article hierarchy), and producing mandatory reporting for German regulatory authorities
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets go down to the named artefacts — the monthly closing in Excel, Geographical Business Unit mappings, article hierarchy — and the posting carries a signed quote from the hiring manager.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: by being the bridge between Finance and the Data Team, ensuring that CFO, Controlling, Accounting, and FP&A teams have reliable, data-driven insights for strategic decisions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Every responsibility points at the finance function — CFO, Controlling, Accounting and FP&A — with no product or commercial audience named.
evidence.autonomy_level: by defining and governing key financial metrics (KPIs), ensuring consistency and accuracy across all finance reports
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Real ownership of the finance data domain ("defining and governing key financial metrics") sits alongside recurring delivery for the finance team, including "running the monthly financial sales closing process (Excel)".
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI is mentioned anywhere; the automation asked for is RPA in SAP (UiPath, Power Automate, SAP scripting), which is rules-based tooling rather than an AI expectation.
evidence.testing_framing: by translating finance business requirements into robust, well-tested data models and automated reporting solutions
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality is framed as owned in the responsibilities — well-tested models plus "ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and governance" — with dbt tests and CI/CD named separately in the requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: reliability and attention to detail in recurring operational tasks such as closing processes, regulatory reporting, and data maintenance ensuring precision and consistency
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Risk framing dominates: the fear is wrong numbers reaching the CFO or a regulator, with mandatory regulatory reporting and closing accuracy named as core duties.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: by identifying and prioritizing automation opportunities to reduce manual finance operations over time
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both builds a new finance modelling layer ("help build the financial analytics backbone") and works down an existing manual estate of spreadsheets and mapping tables.
evidence.language_gate: very good written and spoken English skills; German is a plus
evidence.urgency: A full-time position at our Headquarters in Hamburg starting immediately.
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing is regulatory and trust-led: "by owning critical recurring finance operations, including running the monthly financial sales closing process (Excel) ... and producing mandatory reporting for German regulatory authorities", reinforced by the requirement for "reliability and attention to detail in recurring operational tasks such as closing processes, regulatory reporting".
